name: Nepa Agent-Ready API Catalog
description: Machine-readable catalog of Nepa AB's AI-agent-facing resources: the semantic agent page, llms.txt/ai.txt discovery files, REST API, OpenAPI spec, MCP server, and sitemap.

apis.name: Nepa Agent Page
apis.description: Single semantic HTML5 page — the complete machine-readable representation of Nepa for LLMs and AI agents.

apis.name: Nepa llms.txt
apis.description: Plain-text structured summary of Nepa for LLM crawlers, per the llms.txt spec (llmstxt.org).

apis.name: Nepa ai.txt
apis.description: AI permissions file declaring what AI agents may do with Nepa's content.

apis.name: Nepa Agent REST API
apis.description: Clean, WordPress-agnostic JSON REST API serving company, product, solution, case-study, team, office, jobs, events, blog, press-release, company-news, and investor-relations data, plus a contact submission endpoint.

properties.description: API discovery document.
Field-level schema reference for all entities.
Company profile and leadership summary.
12 products (including the Nepa Trinity bundle), filterable by ?category=.
6 solutions by business need (including the BrandGrow Program).
8 industries served.
20 client case studies, filterable by ?industry=&segment=&service=.
9 leadership/board members.
Office locations (Stockholm HQ, Finland).
Open roles (links to external hiring portal; none listed on-site at time of writing).
30 events/webinars with status (upcoming/past/on-demand).
261 blog/insight posts (246 English, 15 Swedish), paginated via ?limit=&offset=. Filter with ?language=en|sv.
287 investor/press releases (136 English, 151 Swedish), paginated via ?limit=&offset=. Filter with ?language=en|sv and ?category=.
12 client-win/partnership announcements.
34 gated thought-leadership reports, downloads, positioning/campaign landing pages, and trust pages (security disclosure, DEI, whistleblower).

Published "from" prices for all three priced products: Brand Tracking (from 1,500 EUR / 16,300 SEK per month), Marketing Mix Modelling (from 33,000 EUR one-time) and Campaign Pulse (from 5,700 EUR), 11 tiers, with notes on the product-page price discrepancy.
Financial reports, calendar, governance links. Not investment advice.
94 Swedish, Finnish and Danish pages with their English equivalents; filter with ?language=sv|fi|da and ?section=
Submit a qualified B2B inquiry — requires agent_context.user_authorized_submission: true.
